item.title: Scheduled maintenance outage for parts of eastern New Providence on Tuesday
item.description: BPL advises customers in Fox Hill & Sans Souci: a planned outage runs Tuesday 9am-11am for line maintenance along Prince Charles Drive. Report outages 24/7 to 225-5275. Outage map: https://www.bplco.com/services/outages

item.title: Restoration update for Eleuthera after generator fault at Rock Sound plant
item.description: BPL crews restored supply to Tarpum Bay & Greencastle this morning. We thank customers for their patience while repairs continue on the rental generation units.

item.title: BPL partners with BEC on solar expansion for the Family Islands
item.description: Remarks from the signing ceremony: 6 MW of new solar for Exuma & Inagua, cutting diesel dependency across the Family Islands. #Bahamas #Energy
